```
1. Generate images     → Leonardo AI / Ideogram
2. Create video/reel   → CapCut (import images + add text/music/transitions)

4. Voiceover           → ElevenLabs (natural) or Google TTS (quick)
5. Talking head videos → D-ID or HeyGen (for brand spokesperson reels)
6. Story templates     → Canva Free or Microsoft Designer
```

## 3. AI Video Reel Scripts with Free Tool Instructions

Every reel below can be made in 15-20 minutes using free tools only. No video editing experience needed.

### General Setup (Do This Once)

1. **Download CapCut** (free): [capcut.com](https://capcut.com) — available on desktop, iOS, and Android
2. **Generate all images first** using Leonardo AI (Section 2 prompts)
3. **Download a background music track** from Pixabay: search "mystical" or "cosmic" or "Indian classical" — download the MP3
4. **Optional voiceover**: Record in ElevenLabs (free 10 min/month) or use your own phone voice recorder

---

### Reel 1 (15s) — "Kya aap apni SAHI rashi jaante hain?"

**Theme**: Most people check the wrong zodiac sign (Sun sign vs Moon sign)

**Step-by-Step Creation**:

**Step 1 — Generate 3 Images in Leonardo AI**

Image 1 prompt:
```
Bold dramatic text concept, dark cosmic background (#060918), a large red X mark glowing over a faded sun symbol, and a golden checkmark glowing over a crescent moon symbol, versus battle style composition, modern digital art, cinematic lighting, no text on image
```

Image 2 prompt:
```
Split comparison image, left side showing a generic newspaper horoscope page faded and blurry, right side showing a detailed golden Vedic birth chart with precise planetary positions glowing brightly, dark navy background, modern infographic style, no text on image
```

Image 3 prompt:
```
Modern smartphone displaying a golden astrology app interface, golden zodiac wheel on screen, dark cosmic background, golden particles floating around, call to action feel, professional app marketing, no text on image
```

**Step 2 — Open CapCut and Create New Project**
- Aspect ratio: 9:16 (vertical/portrait)
- Duration: 15 seconds

**Step 3 — Assemble the Reel**

| Time | What to Do in CapCut |
|------|---------------------|
| 0:00 - 0:03 | Import Image 1. Add zoom-in animation (CapCut > Animation > In > "Zoom In", 0.5s). Add text overlay: **"90% log GALAT rashi check karte hain"** (white bold text, large, centered). Add sound effect: dramatic hit (CapCut > Audio > Sound Effects > search "dramatic") |
| 0:03 - 0:07 | Import Image 2. Add slide-left transition (CapCut > Transitions > "Slide Left"). Add text overlay: **"Sun Sign NAHI — Moon Sign matters!"** (gold text, medium). Add text below: **"Vedic astrology mein Chandra Rashi se rashifal banta hai"** (white, smaller) |
| 0:07 - 0:12 | Import Image 3. Add slow zoom animation. Add text overlay: **"Apni ASLI Chandra Rashi jaanein — FREE"** (gold bold text). Add text below: **"Real astronomical calculations"** (white, smaller) |
| 0:12 - 0:15 | Black/dark screen. Add text: **"myrashifal.in"** (gold, large, centered). Add text below: **"Link in Bio"** (white). Add MyRashifal+ logo as image overlay if available |

**Step 4 — Add Background Music**
- Go to Pixabay.com/music, search "mystical ambient" or "cosmic"
- Recommended: "Ethereal" or "Mystic Journey" type tracks
- Download MP3, import into CapCut > Audio > add to timeline
- Lower volume to 30-40% so text is the focus

**Step 5 — Add Auto-Captions (Optional)**
- If you added voiceover: CapCut > Text > Auto Captions > Hindi
- CapCut will auto-generate subtitles

**Step 6 — Export and Post**
- Export at 1080p
- Post to Instagram Reels

**Instagram Caption**:
```
Kya aap bhi Sun sign check karte ho? Vedic astrology mein Moon sign (Chandra Rashi) se aapka asli rashifal banta hai.

Apni sahi Chandra Rashi jaanein — Free Kundli banayein myrashifal.in par.

#VedicAstrology #MoonSign #ChandraRashi #Rashifal #MyRashifal #Jyotish #ज्योतिष #चंद्रराशि #SunVsMoon #AstrologyFacts
```

## 4. Instagram Story Ad Templates (Free — Using Canva)

All templates use Canva Free. No Canva Pro needed.

### How to Set Up in Canva (One-Time)

1. Go to [canva.com](https://canva.com) and sign up free
2. Click "Create a design" > "Instagram Story" (1080x1920)
3. Set background color to `#060918`
4. These instructions create each template from scratch

---

### Story Template 1 — Daily Rashifal Teaser

**Canva Steps**:
1. New Instagram Story > Background: `#060918`
2. Elements > search "zodiac" > pick a golden zodiac symbol > place at center, resize to 200px
3. Text > Add heading: "आज का राशिफल" > Font: any serif font > Color: `#c9951a` > Size: 48 > Place at top
4. Text > Add subheading: Rashi name in Hindi (e.g., "मेष राशि / Aries") > Color: white > Size: 36 > Place below zodiac symbol

## 8. Meta Ads Manager Setup Guide

Step-by-step instructions to launch your first Instagram ad campaign. Estimated setup time: 30 minutes.

### Prerequisites

- [x] Instagram Business Account (switch in Settings > Account > Switch to Professional Account)
- [x] Facebook Page for MyRashifal+ (create at facebook.com/pages/create)
- [x] Instagram linked to Facebook Page (Instagram > Settings > Account > Linked Accounts)
- [x] Meta Business Suite account (business.facebook.com)
- [x] Payment method added (credit/debit card or UPI)

### Step 1: Open Meta Ads Manager

1. Go to [adsmanager.facebook.com](https://adsmanager.facebook.com)
2. Click the green **"+ Create"** button

### Step 2: Choose Campaign Objective

For your first campaign:
- Select **"Traffic"** (this sends people to myrashifal.in)
- Campaign name: "MyRashifal - Free Kundli - Feb 2026"
- Turn OFF "Advantage Campaign Budget" for now (we want manual control)
- Click "Next"

### Step 3: Set Up Ad Set

**Ad Set Name**: "Astrology Enthusiasts - India - 18-45"

**Budget & Schedule**:
- Daily budget: **Rs.500** (start low, scale what works)
- Start date: Today
- End date: Leave open (you can pause anytime)

**Audience**:
- **Location**: India
- **Age**: 18-45
- **Gender**: All
- **Languages**: Hindi, English

**Detailed Targeting** (click "Browse" > "Interests"):
- Type and select each:
  - Astrology
  - Horoscope
  - Vedic astrology
  - Zodiac signs
  - Kundli
  - Jyotish
  - Rashifal
  - Spiritual healing

**Placements**:
- Select **"Manual Placements"**
- Check ONLY:
  - Instagram Feed
  - Instagram Stories
  - Instagram Reels
  - Instagram Explore
- Uncheck everything else (Facebook, Audience Network, etc.)

Click "Next"

### Step 4: Create the Ad

**Ad Name**: "Free Kundli Hero - Square Image"

**Identity**:
- Select your Instagram account
- Select your Facebook page

**Ad Setup**:
- Format: **Single image**
- Upload the image you generated from **Ad 1** (Section 2)

**Ad Creative**:
- **Primary text**: Use the Hindi or English caption from Ad 1 (Section 2)
- **Headline**: "Free Janam Kundli | मुफ़्त जन्म कुंडली"
- **Description**: "Real astronomical calculations. Not generic predictions."
- **Call to action button**: Select **"Learn More"**
- **Website URL**: `https://myrashifal.in`

**Tracking**:
- If you have Meta Pixel installed: select it here
- If not: skip for now (set up pixel later for retargeting)

### Step 5: Review & Publish

1. Click **"Publish"**
2. Meta will review your ad (usually approved within 1-24 hours)
3. Once approved, your ad starts running automatically

### Step 6: Monitor & Optimize (After 3-5 Days)

Go to Ads Manager and check these metrics:

| Metric | Good | Action if Bad |
|--------|------|--------------|
| **CTR (Click-Through Rate)** | Above 1% | Change image or headline |
| **CPC (Cost Per Click)** | Below Rs.8 | Good — continue |
| **CPC** | Above Rs.15 | Pause ad, try a different creative |
| **Reach** | 1,000+ per day at Rs.500 | Normal |
| **Frequency** | Below 3.0 | If above 3, audience is seeing ad too many times — expand audience |

### Optimization Tips

1. **Week 1**: Run Ad 1 (Free Kundli) and Ad 2 (Daily Rashifal) simultaneously at Rs.500/day each. See which gets better CTR.
2. **Week 2**: Pause the losing ad. Double budget on the winner to Rs.1,000/day. Add Ad 4 (Career Report) at Rs.500/day.
3. **Week 3**: Scale winner to Rs.1,500/day. Test Ad 3 (Matching) and Ad 5 (App) at Rs.500/day each.
4. **Ongoing**: Every week, pause ads with CTR below 0.8%. Scale ads with CTR above 1.5%. Refresh creatives every 2-3 weeks (generate new images with slightly modified prompts).

### Budget Summary

| Phase | Daily Budget | Monthly Budget | What's Running |
|-------|-------------|---------------|----------------|
| Week 1-2 (Testing) | Rs.500-1,000 | Rs.7,000-14,000 | 2 ads at Rs.500 each |
| Week 3-4 (Scaling) | Rs.1,500-2,000 | Rs.21,000-28,000 | 1 winner scaled + 1-2 new tests |
| Month 2+ (Optimized) | Rs.2,000-3,000 | Rs.28,000-42,000 | Top 2-3 performers + retargeting |
